RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the March 5, 2008/Phalguna 15, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Earth Sciences; Home Affairs;
 Information and Broadcasting; Labour  and Employment; Parliamentary
Affairs; Rural Development; Science and Technology; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
31
CAG   report    regarding
misappropriation of funds
 under  NREGS
*101. SHRI C. RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH: Will the Minister of
RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Comptroller and
Auditor General in his report has found
cases where the funds earmarked to
National Rural Employment Guarantee
Scheme (NREGS) have been
misappropriated;
(b) if so, whether any steps have been
taken to check the occurrences of
misappropriation of funds allocated to the
NREGS;
(c) if so, the details thereof along with
the  level of compliance by the implementing
bodies; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
 Non-availability of central forces for
the naxal affected States
*102. SHRIMATI SUPRIYA SULE:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Centre has reportedly told
the naxal affected States that they should
not ask for more Central Reserve Police
Force to handle naxalism in their States;
(b) whether the Centre has also asked
States that they  should focus on filling up
the vacant posts in their police set up;
(c) whether this matter was debated at
the two-day meeting of the task force,
constituted by the Union Home Ministry
on the naxalite problem in the country;
(d) if so, the reactions of the States to
these proposals; and
(e) the steps being taken by the States
in this regard?
 Terrorist camps near Hubli
*103. SHRI V. NARAYANASAMY:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that terrorist
camps have been unearthed in the forests
near Hubli and the Karnataka Police has
arrested three terrorists;
(b) whether Government has identified
terrorist organization supporting this
terrorist group; and

32
(c) the plan of action of Government to
control the spread of terrorist organizations
throughout the country?
 Special law to curb boot-legging and
property grabbing
*104. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state whether Government is
considering to promulgate a special law to
curb the unlawful activities  of boot-leggers
and property grabbers?
 Gap between requirement of officers and
their recruitment in armed forces
*105. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether a large gap has arisen
between the requirement of officers in the
three wings of our Defence Forces and the
numbers recruited over the last several
years;
(b) if so, the reasons for the same;
(c) the steps being contemplated, if any,
by Government to address the issue;
(d) whether it is a fact that recruitment
of jawans in the Defence Forces has been
unsatisfactory in terms of number of
enthusiasts opting for the career, especially
in the regions which have been traditionally
attracting young generations to the forces;
(e) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(f) the steps contemplated to improve
it?
 Modernization of NTC mills
*106. SHRI RA VULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: W ill the Minister of
TEXTILES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has spent about Rs. 530 crore for
modernization of NTC mills and the
production facilities have been upgraded;
(b) if so, the details thereof during the
last three years especially in Andhra
Pradesh; and
(c) the future programme of NTC in the
country?
 Upgradation of ITIs as Centres of
Excellence
*107. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI HARISH RAWA T:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT  be pleased to state:
(a) what are the elements of the Centres
of Excellence for the ITIs;
(b) on what basis are they selected under
this scheme;
(c) of these, in how many, the Institute
Management Committees (IMCs) with
private participation are in place and how
are the Members of the IMC selected; and
(d) how many of the 100 ITIs taken up
for upgradation during 2006-07, have
availed the aid from World Bank and what
is the pattern of financing this project?
 Distribution of Indian movies
through pirated VCD/DVD
*108. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that VCD/DVD
producers are duping Government of large
sums  by distributing Indian movies through
piracy without paying prescribed Rs. 10/-
per VCD/DVD;

33
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps being taken to ensure
lawful distribution of Indian films through
VCD/DVD?
